# ZoomPhant — AI-Native Time-Series Database (TSDB) & Enterprise Monitoring
> Self-hosted, 100% customer-owned observability built for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Cursor) and enterprise infrastructure.

ZoomPhant delivers two complementary products with zero vendor data lock-in:

## 1. ZoomPhant TSDB (Serverless Cloudflare BYOC)
An AI-native unified metrics, logs, and structured events database deployed in 60 seconds into the user's own Cloudflare account.

- **Built-in Hosted MCP Server (`POST /mcp`)**: Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP server with 19 scope-filtered tools (`discover`, `get_schema`, `validate_zql`, `run_zql`, `upsert_summary`, `upsert_dashboard`, `upsert_alert_rule`, `apply_bundle`, etc.) and documentation resources. Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Antigravity directly with a Bearer token — no local proxy or sidecar required.
- **Self-Describing Agent Protocol**: Every deployed TSDB instance serves `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, `/openapi.yaml`, `/api/v1/tools`, `/api/v1/whoami`, and `/api/v1/discover`.
- **Declarative GitOps Apply (`POST /api/v1/apply`)**: Idempotent, all-or-nothing pre-validated apply for `{ schemas, summaries, extract, sketches, dashboards, rules }` with `?dryRun=true` (read-only PR checks), `scope` label injection, and `onConflict: "skip"`.
- **Least-Privilege Agent Scopes**: `read`, `write` (ingest + declare schema), `config` (dashboards, accelerators, alerts, templates, schema — no token/tenant admin access), and `admin`. Tokens support up to 4 scope tags (e.g. `env="prod"`, `dept="core"`).
- **ZQL v3 Unified Query Language**: Pipe-based query language across `| metrics`, `| events`, and `| logs` with `# @gadget {...}` visual metadata pragmas and `<10ms` zero-scan Event Summary acceleration.
- **Pricing**: First BYOC TSDB instance is 100% free and runs on Cloudflare Free Tier ($0/mo for light workloads) or Cloudflare Workers Paid ($5/mo for 10K–100K+ events/day).
- **Live TSDB Docs & Spec**: https://tsdb.zoomphant.com/docs · https://tsdb.zoomphant.com/llms.txt

### Quick MCP Client Configuration
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "zoomphant-tsdb": {
      "url": "https://your-tsdb.workers.dev/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer tsdb_read_config_token..." }
    }
  }
}
```

## 2. ZoomPhant Enterprise Monitoring (Self-Hosted & Hybrid)
A single-image, all-in-one infrastructure and application monitoring platform for dedicated servers, Kubernetes, and private clouds.

- **Broad Coverage**: Linux, Windows (WMI), **NVIDIA GPU monitoring** (utilization, VRAM, temperature, power, ECC errors), Kubernetes, Docker, Proxmox VE, VMware, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, SNMP network devices, and synthetic HTTP/SSL checks.
- **Pricing**: Free for personal use and registered startups/SMBs (community business tier); enterprise licensing and complimentary pre-implementation consulting available.
